dataset_name: Indicative City-wise Surface Water pH - UP Delhi Haryana
important_warning: pH alone cannot determine overall water quality or drinking-water safety. These city-level values are suitable for prototype visualization only unless backed by a specific monitoring station and sampling date.

reference.up_jjm: Uttar Pradesh Jal Jeevan Mission / Namami Gange

pH_reference.interpretation: Values inside this range should not automatically be labeled bad; BOD, DO, fecal coliform, TDS, heavy metals and other parameters can determine overall condition.
